description: Generate the current TOTP code (RFC 6238) from a base32-encoded shared secret, plus how many seconds remain before it rotates. Defaults (30s period, 6 digits, SHA-1) match what Google Authenticator and most other authenticator apps use. Pass an explicit timestamp for deterministic/testable output.

secret.description: The base32-encoded shared secret (RFC 4648, case-insensitive, padding optional)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds to compute the code for; defaults to the current time

name: generate_totp
